intro: The salute emoji 🫡 is internet shorthand for 'yes sir' — a crisp hand to the brow that reads as respect, acknowledgment, or playful mock-deference when someone asks you to do the impossible. This page gathers the whole respect range: the 🖖 Vulcan salute and ✋ raised hand for formal gestures, medals and ribbons like 🎖️ for honor and recognition, deep 🙇 bows for showing deference, and classic salute kaomoji like (｀・ω・)ゞ that paste anywhere plain text works. Grab a single symbol, or copy a ready-made combo set for chats, comments, and replies.
